== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Adrienne Lamarkis Daiasus is a noblewoman associated with the [[Damascan]] realm and the city of [[Bel Calem]]. As the wife of [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]] Daiasus, she has been noted for her competence in managing his realm and maintaining its smooth operation. Following the death of her husband, she assumed a leadership role in managing the territory and oversaw efforts to evacuate citizens during times of crisis. Her status is such that she is addressed as a lady of [[Damasca]], and she has daughters who accompany her. During periods of conflict, she has demonstrated a commanding presence, issuing orders to guards and military advisors to secure her home and protect the population from potential threats like [[Incarnations]] or invading [[Travelers]].}}
